name: Visual Line Numbers
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Highlight the current row, the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
tip: In Vim mode, type 5gj to go to the row that shows 5. With Vimrc Support, nmap j gj makes 5j do the same.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Visual Line Numbers is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
